traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Haemodoraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior, half inferior or inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary, in panicles, in cymes or in racemes; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit usually capsule, rarely nut; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 3 to 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Haemodoraceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other. Its flowers are not mostly zygomorphic, so a plant of it states its own symmetry; one that is zygomorphic draws this kind, and one stating none is drawn regular.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 243, 244, 245, family Haemodoraceae: phyllotaxis pattern distichous; read as "distichous".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 243, 244, 245, family Haemodoraceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".
